definition: strips of potato fried in deep fat
description: A red-haired young man in a navy coat sits on a bench on a seaside promenade holding an open paper cone of thick golden fried potato strips and eating one. A large grey and white gull stands on the arm of the bench beside him, then leans in and pulls a strip straight out of the cone. More gulls swoop down at his head; he hunches over and curls both hands around the paper cone to shield it, and in the last shot a whole flock has him surrounded on the bench.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er schützt seine Pommes vor den Möwen.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está protegiendo sus patatas fritas de las gaviotas.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il protège ses frites des mouettes.
